檢查.內容:
診斷：                                                        
１見描述　　　　　　　　　　　                                
Dimethicone oral, 50 mg                                         
Scopolamine ivd, 20 mg                                          
10% Lidocaine spray Y                                           
Plain film before ERCP:                                         
No apparent finding.                                            
                                                                
Endoscopic finding:                                             
                                                                
Some linear mucosal defects < 5 mm at EG junction were noted    
and Reflux esophagitis (Los Angeles grade A) were seen. Naive   
major papilla was noted.                                        
                                                                
                                                                
ERP:                                                            
Initail accidental cannulation into PD with sphincterotome      
(Olympus) was done by using guidewire assistance.               
Transpancreatic Sphincterotomy (0.5cm) smoothly with            
Sphincterotome was used after PD cannulation. A PD stent(4Fr x  
5cm) implanted to prevent post-ERCP pancreatitis. Successful    
CBD cannulation was done after then.                            
                                                                
ERC:                                                            
Cannulation into IHD was done successfully by catheter and      
guidewire. CBD sized 1.34cm was noted. Filling defect sized     
1.20cm x 1.50cm was noted, suspect stone related. 1ml dirty     
bile was aspirated for culture.Endoscopic papillary large       
balloon dilatation (EPLBD) with dilation balloon (12mm, 3atm, 5 
minutes) was done smoothly. Stone Retrieval Balloon was applied 
and one huge yellowish stones and several sludges were          
retracted.                                                      
                                                                
                                                                
Plain film:                                                     
Following plain film showed PD stent in situ and pneumobilia,   
and no more filling defect inside CBD.                          
                                                                
Impression:                                                     
. CBD stone s/p TPS+EPLBD, with successful stones retraction ,  
s/p ERPD for post-ERCP pancreatitis prevention                  
                                                                
Suggestion:                                                     
. NPO for one day                                               
. Follow CBC, T.Bil, Amylase, Lipase in coming morning          
. monitor post ERCP complication(infection,bleeding,perforation)
. follow up KUB for PD stent evalutaiton, arrange EGD removal   
in one to three months
